Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.
Falls Sie eine Störmeldung  für eine Ladestation auf einem Siemens Betriebsgelände abgesetzt haben,  werden wir diese an den Verantwortlichen des Betriebsgeländes weiterleiten. Sie erhalten keine weiteren Rückmeldungen.

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0479373
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P9 312561850/01
Charger ID / Serial No.:
jRLjhx
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Please send a technician remove and reinsert HMI display cable and verify the 24V at the entrance of PCB. If the troubleshooting step does not work, please proceed with the replacement of the HMI.
Here are the MLFB:
Quantity                                 MLFB                                                          Description
1                                      8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1                   Controlpanel RAFI3 segments w/o AC cutout
1                                      8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8                   Controlpanel RAFI middle segment contacless CCR
1                                      8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6                   Controlpanel Adaptation Set DLogic Gen1 -RAFI
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.

Harun Ar Rashid
